CJP Founder Abhijeet Dipke Announces School Campaign and Hints at New Protest

CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke has announced a nationwide campaign to improve village schools, set to begin on August 15 from Maharashtra. He also hinted at the potential for a "Jantar Mantar Season 2" protest, stating it would commence soon if certain conditions are not met. Separately, a Mumbai 'influencer' filed a complaint against Dipke and others regarding the presence of minors at a CJP protest. Dipke also spoke with Devendra Mahto, who claimed to have been lathi-charged, and supported a road-to-school protest in Uttar Pradesh.
